name: undated-entity
description: Clean site with the Organization JSON-LD stripped of sameAs, every visible date removed (no time elements, no dates in text, a copyright line without a year), and no newsroom: the News link, footer Newsroom link, home 'Latest news' section, in-copy newsroom links and the blog's sitemap entries are gone.

expected.notes: sameas_missing is medium (Organization present, no sameAs); sameas_no_authority is then not_evaluated (dependency_failed), no finding. no_visible_dates is low for saas (medium only for publishers). The contact page keeps a press@ mailto link: mailto links never count as a press surface, so press_page_missing (low) fires because no page has the blog role and no internal link is labelled press/news/blog. Five roles are sampled; blog is a missing role.
